name: Agent Buddy
description: Helps ServiceNow fulfillers and team leads work tickets faster: summaries, reply drafts, resolution notes and reports. Reads with your own session, masks personal data before any AI call, never writes to ServiceNow.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src https: http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
